caption:
A significantly overdue invoice from an important customer requires a careful balance — pursuing payment firmly, without damaging a relationship that matters to the business.

While that process plays out, invoice finance can cover the interim cash-flow gap, so your own operations aren't held hostage to someone else's payment timeline.
